name: test_every_known_issue_pattern_matches_an_inventoried_test
description:
Objective: Every quarantine pattern matches at least one inventoried automated test.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Match each registry pattern against the Automated inventory node IDs.
Expected: 1. No pattern is stale; a removed or renamed test fails this case.
